title: Dance Class to Empower Your Inner Dance Queen
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: A vibrant dance class designed for every woman looking to embrace her confidence and unleash her inner strength. We create a supportive community where participants can connect and empower one another through the joy of dance. No experience is necessary; it's about finding freedom of expression and transforming self-doubt into self-assurance. Witness your own growth as you learn to dance in heels, supported by a sisterhood that celebrates every move you make. This is more than a class; it’s a journey towards self-discovery and empowerment.
